title: CS 4535: Your First Implementation Ticket
description: Due Mon Oct 19, 23:59 ET. About 5 minutes once your issue is open.
completedHtml:
Submitted.

I agree scopes on the issues. Watch yours for my reply, and answer questions there. Review-ready is Thu Oct 29.

elements.name: intro
elements.html: The issue is where your scope gets agreed. This survey is how I find every issue in one place. If your ticket doesn't have an issue yet, open one on pawtograder/platform first, post your plan there, and tag @jon-bell. See First Implementation Ticket.

elements.name: issue_url
elements.title: Link to your ticket's issue on pawtograder/platform
elements.description: For a pool XL group or a stack, link the issue that holds your plan.

validators.text: Paste the full link to an issue on pawtograder/platform, such as https://github.com/pawtograder/platform/issues/977

choices.text: My own project: my sprint artifact, my team's issues, or my Agents Activity analysis

elements.name: done_when
elements.title: Done when... (one sentence that names a user)
elements.description: For example: "A TA grading a scanned exam sees each answer's crop at its true shape."

elements.name: layers
elements.title: Which layers does it touch?
elements.description: XL means more than one layer.

validators.text: An XL ticket touches more than one layer. If yours touches one, it isn't XL yet. Grow it, or tell me on the issue.

elements.name: plan_posted
elements.title: I posted my plan on the issue (the PR stack in order, with a rollback sentence for each) and tagged @jon-bell

validators.text: Post the plan on the issue first. That's where the scope gets agreed.

elements.name: blocker
elements.title: Anything blocking you, or a question you need answered before you start?
